description.en: Authentic supplications from the Holy Quran

title.en: Dua for Good in This Life and the Hereafter

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: The most comprehensive dua in the Quran, as reported by Anas bin Malik: the Prophet ﷺ would often supplicate with it.
virtues.ar: أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة...

title.en: Dua of Adam (AS) for Forgiveness

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
translation.ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

virtues.en: First supplication of Adam (AS) and Hawwa after their descent.
virtues.ar: أول دعاء في الأرض من آدم وحواء.

title.en: Dua for Increase in Knowledge

items.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi zidni ilma.

translation.en: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
translation.ar: رب زدني علماً

virtues.en: The only dua the Prophet ﷺ was commanded to make in the Quran.
virtues.ar: الدعاء الوحيد الذي أمر الله به نبيه في القرآن.

title.en: Dua for Patience & Victory

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا أفرغ علينا صبراً وثبت أقدامنا وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: Dua of Talut's army before facing Jalut (Goliath).
virtues.ar: دعاء جيش طالوت قبل مواجهة جالوت.

title.en: Dua of Yunus (AS)

items.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: No Muslim ever supplicates with it for anything except that Allah responds.
virtues.ar: ما دعا بها مسلم في شيء قط إلا استجاب الله له.

title.en: Dua for Parents

items.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbirhamhuma kama rabbayani saghira.

translation.en: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.
translation.ar: رب ارحمهما كما ربياني صغيراً

virtues.en: Quranic command to supplicate for parents.
virtues.ar: أمر قرآني بالدعاء للوالدين.

title.en: Dua of Musa (AS) for Chest Expansion

items.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.transliteration: Qala Rabbi-shrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wah-lul 'uqdatam min lisani, yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: [Musa] said: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech.
translation.ar: قال رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري واحلل عقدة من لساني يفقوه قولي

virtues.en: Excellent dua for students, speakers, and clarity.
virtues.ar: دعاء موسى عليه السلام لطلب الفصاحة والفهم.

title.en: Dua for Family & Righteousness

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan, innaka sami'ud-du'a'.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة إنك سميع الدعاء

virtues.en: Dua of Zakariya (AS) for a righteous child.
virtues.ar: دعاء زكريا عليه السلام لطلب الولد الصالح.

title.en: Dua for Steadfastness in Faith

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmatan, innaka antal-Wahhab.

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة إنك أنت الوهاب

virtues.en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ often.
virtues.ar: كان النبي ﷺ يكثر منها.

title.en: Dua for Forgiveness of Self, Parents, and Believers

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا ۚ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbana-ghfir lana wa li-ikhwaninal-ladhina sabaquna bil-imani wa la taj'al fi qulubina ghillan lilladhina amanu, Rabbana innaka ra'ufur-rahim.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.
translation.ar: ربنا اغفر لنا ولإخواننا الذين سبقونا بالإيمان...

virtues.en: Excellent dua for purifying the heart from rancor.
virtues.ar: تنقية القلب من الغل.

title.en: Dua for Acceptance of Good Deeds

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna, innaka antas-Sami'ul-'Alim.

translation.en: Our Lord, accept it from us. Indeed, You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
translation.ar: ربنا تقبل منا إنك أنت السميع العليم

virtues.en: Dua of Ibrahim (AS) and Isma'il (AS) when building the Ka'bah.
virtues.ar: دعاء إبراهيم وإسماعيل عليهما السلام عند بناء الكعبة.

title.en: Dua for Ease in Affairs

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast and ease for me my task.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري

virtues.en: Dua of Musa (AS) when sent to Pharaoh. Excellent before any difficult task.
virtues.ar: دعاء موسى عليه السلام عند البعثة.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Hellfire

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana-srif 'anna 'adhaba jahannam, inna 'adhabaha kana gharama.

translation.en: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering.
translation.ar: ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم إن عذابها كان غراماً

virtues.en: Among the supplications of the servants of the Most Merciful (Ibad ur-Rahman).
virtues.ar: من دعاء عباد الرحمن.

title.en: Dua for Spouses & Offspring as Comfort

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.
translation.ar: ربنا هب لنا من أزواجنا وذرياتنا قرة أعين واجعلنا للمتقين إماماً

virtues.en: Dua of the servants of the Most Merciful for a righteous family.
virtues.ar: من دعاء عباد الرحمن.

title.en: Dua for Forgiveness & Mercy

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
translation.ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا...

virtues.en: Dua of Adam and Hawwa after their descent.
virtues.ar: دعاء آدم وحواء عليهما السلام.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Misguidance

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa li bihi 'ilmun, wa illa taghfir li wa tarhamni akun minal-khasirin.

translation.en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be of the losers.
translation.ar: رب إني أعوذ بك أن أسألك ما ليس لي به علم...

virtues.en: Dua of Nuh (AS).
virtues.ar: دعاء نوح عليه السلام.

title.en: Dua for Righteous Children

items.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَيَّ فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi la tathar 'alayya farda wa anta khayrul-warithin.

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no offspring], while You are the best of inheritors.
translation.ar: رب لا تذر علي فرداً وأنت خير الوارثين

virtues.en: Dua of Zakariya (AS) when he was old and had no child.
virtues.ar: دعاء زكريا عليه السلام.

title.en: Dua of Sulaiman (AS) for Gratitude

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardahu wa adkhilni bi-rahmatika fi 'ibadikas-salihin.

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will be pleased and make me righteous with regard to my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
translation.ar: رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت عليّ وعلى والديّ...

virtues.en: Dua of Sulaiman (AS) when he heard the ant's speech.
virtues.ar: دعاء سليمان عليه السلام عند سماع قول النملة.

title.en: Dua for Protection from Wrong Path

items.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ، صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
items.transliteration: Ihdinas-siratal-mustaqim, siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim ghayril-maghdubi 'alayhim wa lad-dallin.

translation.en: Guide us to the straight path — the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
translation.ar: اهدنا الصراط المستقيم، صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم...

virtues.en: The most recited dua in the Quran — recited in every unit of prayer (Fatihah).
virtues.ar: أكثر دعاء يقرأ في القرآن — في كل ركعة.

title.en: Dua of Yunus in the Whale's Belly

items.arabic: فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Fanada fiz-zulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: And he called out within the darknesses: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: فنادى في الظلمات أن لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: Called 'the supplication of distress' — never refused.
virtues.ar: دعاء الكرب، لا يُردّ.

title.en: Al-Fatihah — The Greatest Supplication

items.arabic: Ihdinas-siratal mustaqeem, siratal-ladhina an'amta 'alayhim, ghayril-maghduubi 'alayhim wa lad-daaalleen.
items.transliteration: Ihdinas-siratal mustaqeem...

translation.en: Guide us to the straight path - the path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
translation.ar: اهدنا الصراط المستقيم صراط الذين أنعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "No prayer is valid without the recitation of Al-Fatihah." (Sahih al-Bukhari 756). It is called "The Mother of the Quran" and contains the essence of the entire message.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "لا صلاة لمن لم يقرأ بفاتحة الكتاب" (البخاري 756)

title.en: The Supplication of Prophet Adam and Hawa

items.arabic: Rabbana thalamna anfusana wa ilam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasireen.
items.transliteration: Rabbana thalamna anfusana wa ilam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
translation.ar: ربنا ظلمنا أنفسنا وإن لم تغفر لنا وترحمنا لنكونن من الخاسرين

virtues.en: This is the first dua recorded in the Quran, spoken by Adam and Hawa after they disobeyed Allah by eating from the forbidden tree. It teaches us the proper way to seek forgiveness: acknowledge the wrong, ask for forgiveness, and ask for mercy. (Quran 7:23)
virtues.ar: هذا أول دعاء في القرآن، قاله آدم وحواء بعد المعصية (القرآن 7:23)

title.en: The Supplication of Prophet Nuh

items.arabic: Rabbi inni maghloobun fantasir.
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni maghloobun fantasir.

translation.en: My Lord, indeed I am overpowered, so help.
translation.ar: رب إني مغلوب فانتصر

virtues.en: Prophet Nuh made this dua after 950 years of calling his people to Islam with only a handful of believers responding. It shows that even the greatest prophets turned to Allah in moments of apparent helplessness. (Quran 54:10)
virtues.ar: دعا نوح ربه بعد 950 عاماً من الدعوة (القرآن 54:10)

title.en: The Comprehensive Dua of Prophet Ibrahim

items.arabic: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a. Rabbi ij'alni muqeemas-salati wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a...

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication. My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة إنك سميع الدعاء رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة ومن ذريتي ربنا وتقبل دعاء

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim combined prayers for righteous offspring, the establishment of prayer for himself and his descendants, and acceptance of his supplications. Allah answered by granting him Ishmael, Ishaq, and the prophethood in his lineage. (Quran 14:39-40)
virtues.ar: جمع إبراهيم بين الدعاء للذرية الصالحة وإقامة الصلاة فاستجاب الله له (القرآن 14:39-40)

title.en: Prophet Musa's Dua for Confidence

items.arabic: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wauhlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli.
items.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wauhlul 'uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue so that they may understand my speech.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري واحلل عقدة من لساني يفقهوا قولي

virtues.en: Prophet Musa made this dua before going to Pharaoh. It teaches us to ask Allah for confidence, ease in our tasks, and clear communication. (Quran 20:25-28)
virtues.ar: دعا موسى ربه قبل الذهاب إلى فرعون (القرآن 20:25-28)

title.en: The Dua of Prophet Ayyub for Healing

items.arabic: Annee massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen.
items.transliteration: Annee massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-raahimeen.

translation.en: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
translation.ar: أني مسني الضر وأنت أرحم الراحمين

virtues.en: Prophet Ayyub was afflicted with illness and the loss of his wealth and children for many years. He never stopped being grateful. When he finally made this dua, Allah healed him and returned to him everything doubled. (Quran 21:83)
virtues.ar: ابتلي أيوب بالمرض وفقد المال والولد سنوات طويلة فلما دعا ربه شفاه وأعطاه ضعف ما كان (القرآن 21:83)

title.en: The Dua of Prophet Yunus — The Dua of the Distressed

items.arabic: La ilaha illa ant, subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen.
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa ant, subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimeen.

translation.en: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
translation.ar: لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: This is the dua Prophet Yunus made inside the belly of the whale. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "No Muslim ever supplicates to Allah with this for any matter except that Allah answers it." (Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3505). It is called the "Dua of the Distressed."
virtues.ar: هذا دعاء يونس في بطن الحوت. قال النبي ﷺ: "لا يدعو مسلم ربه بهذا الدعاء في شيء قط إلا استجاب له" (الترمذي 3505)

title.en: The Believers' Dua for Protection from Evil

items.arabic: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhab.
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobana ba'da idz hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah...

translation.en: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد إذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمة إنك أنت الوهاب

virtues.en: The scholars of the Salaf would recite this dua frequently, recognizing that guidance is from Allah and that hearts can deviate at any moment. It is a dua for steadfastness after receiving guidance. (Quran 3:8)
virtues.ar: كان السلف يداومون على هذا الدعاء إدراكاً أن الهداية من الله (القرآن 3:8)

title.en: The Dua for Good in This World and the Next

items.arabic: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah, wafil-akhirati hasanah, wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanah, wafil-akhirati hasanah, wa qina 'adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: Anas reported that the Prophet (peace be upon him) used to supplicate the most with this dua. It is the most comprehensive prayer for all-round well-being. (Sahih al-Bukhari 6389, Sahih Muslim 2721)
virtues.ar: كان أكثر دعاء النبي ﷺ: "ربنا آتنا في الدنيا حسنة وفي الآخرة حسنة وقنا عذاب النار" (البخاري 6389، مسلم 2721)

title.en: The Believers' Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy

items.arabic: Rabbana afaghfir lana dhunoobana wa israfina fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wa nsurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen.
items.transliteration: Rabbana afaghfir lana dhunoobana wa israfina fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wa nsurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affair and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وإسرافنا في أمرنا وثبت أقدامنا وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: This comprehensive dua covers four essentials: forgiveness of sins, forgiveness of excesses, steadfastness, and victory. (Quran 3:147)
virtues.ar: يشمل هذا الدعاء أربعة أساسيات: المغفرة والثبات والنصر (القرآن 3:147)

title.en: The Dua of Prophet Zakariya for a Child

items.arabic: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a.
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka sami'ud-du'a.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة إنك سميع الدعاء

virtues.en: Allah answered this dua by granting Prophet Zakariya a son, Yahya (John the Baptist), despite his old age and his wife's infertility. (Quran 3:38, 21:90)
virtues.ar: استجاب الله دعاء زكريا ووهبه يحيى رغم كبر سنه وعقم زوجته (القرآن 3:38)

title.en: The Dua of the Youth of the Cave

items.arabic: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashad.
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashad.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا من لدنك رحمة وهيئ لنا من أمرنا رشدا

virtues.en: The youth who fled to the cave made this dua, asking Allah for mercy and guidance in their difficult situation. Allah answered them in the most extraordinary way. (Quran 18:10)
virtues.ar: دعا الفتية الذين لجأوا إلى الكهف فاستجاب الله لهم بأعجب طريقة (القرآن 18:10)

title.en: Seeking Refuge from Envy and the Evil Eye

items.arabic: Wa idha hasada hasidun fal-yasta'idh bin-nasi wa yatawakkal 'alal-'azeezir-raheem.
items.transliteration: Wa idha hasada hasidun fal-yasta'idh bin-nasi wa yatawakkal 'alal-'azeezir-raheem.

translation.en: And if an evil envious person should envy, let him seek refuge with Allah... and upon the Most Merciful let the envier rely.
translation.ar: وإذا حسد الحاسدون فليستعيذوا بالناس

virtues.en: Allah teaches us that the remedy for envy and the evil eye is to seek refuge in Him and to rely upon the Most Merciful. (Quran 23:97-98)
virtues.ar: يعلمنا الله أن علاج الحسد والعين هو الاستعاذة به والتوكل على الرحمن (القرآن 23:97-98)

title.en: Lord of the East and West — Control of All Affairs

items.arabic: Rabbal-mashriqi wal-maghribi la ilaha illa huwa fattakhidhhu wakeela.
items.transliteration: Rabbal-mashriqi wal-maghribi la ilaha illa huwa fattakhidhhu wakeela.

translation.en: Lord of the east and the west - there is no deity except Him - so take Him as a Disposer of Affairs.
translation.ar: رب المشرق والمغرب لا إله إلا هو فاتخذه وكيلا

virtues.en: This declaration affirms Allah's sovereignty over all directions and all affairs. Taking Him as a Wakeel (disposer of affairs) is the ultimate act of tawakkul (reliance). (Quran 73:9)
virtues.ar: إقرار بملوك الله على كل الاتجاهات والأمور (القرآن 73:9)

title.en: Our Lord, Forgive Our Parents and the Believers

items.arabic: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab.
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
translation.ar: رب اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim included his parents in his dua, teaching us the importance of praying for our parents' forgiveness. (Quran 14:41, 14:40-41)
virtues.ar: أدخل إبراهيم والديه في دعائه (القرآن 14:41)

title.en: The Dua at the End of Surah Al-Baqarah

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۖ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alalladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tahmilna ma la taqata lana bihi, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta maulana fa-nsurna 'alal-qawmil-kafireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, do not burden us beyond our capacity and pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا كما حملته على الذين من قبلنا ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا أنت مولانا فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that Allah answered the two verses at the end of Surah Al-Baqarah, and whoever recites them at night, they will be sufficient for him. (Sahih al-Bukhari 1110, Sahih Muslim 771). This dua asks Allah not to overburden us, to pardon and forgive us, and to grant us victory.
virtues.ar: قال النبي ﷺ: "قيل ليلة الإسراء: إن أمتك لا يستطيعون أن يحملوا ذلك" ثم قال: "آيتان أعطيتهما من كنز الكعبة: ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا..." (البخاري 1110، مسلم 771)

title.en: The Believers' Dua Affirming the Day of Judgment

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana innaka jami'un-nasi li-yawmin la rayba fih, innallaha la yukhliful-mi'ad.

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise.
translation.ar: ربنا إنك جامع الناس ليوم لا ريب فيه إن الله لا يخلف الميعاد

virtues.en: This dua is made by those who possess knowledge of the Hereafter, affirming their certainty about the Day of Judgment and Allah's promise. It strengthens one's belief in the afterlife. (Quran 3:9)
virtues.ar: هذا دعاء أهل العلم بالله واليوم الآخر يؤكد يقينهم بالحساب (القرآن 3:9)

title.en: The Believers' Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Fire
title.ar: دعاء المؤمنين للمغفرة والنجاة من النار

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana inna amanna faghfir lana dhunubana wa qina 'adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا إنا آمنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: A concise yet powerful dua combining faith, forgiveness, and seeking protection from Hellfire. Made by those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned. (Quran 3:16)
virtues.ar: دعاء موجز يجمع بين الإيمان والمغفرة والاستعاذة من النار (القرآن 3:16)

title.en: The Dua of Maryam's Mother (Hannah)

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni nadhartu laka ma fi batni muharraran fataqabbal minni, innaka antas-sami'ul-'aleem.

translation.en: My Lord, indeed I have vowed to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
translation.ar: رب إني نذرت لك ما في بطني محررا فتقبل مني إنك أنت السميع العليم

virtues.en: The mother of Maryam (Hannah) made this sincere dua dedicating her unborn child to Allah's service. Allah accepted her vow and granted her Maryam, who became the mother of Prophet Isa. (Quran 3:35-36)
virtues.ar: نذرت أم مريم (حنة) وليدها لله فاستجاب الله وأعطاها مريم أم عيسى (القرآن 3:35-36)

title.en: The Dua of the Disciples (Hawariyyun) of Isa

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana amanna bima anzalta wa-ittaba'na-r-rasula fa-ktubna ma'ash-shahideen.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses [to truth].
translation.ar: ربنا آمنا بما أنزلت واتبعنا الرسول فاكتبنا مع الشاهدين

virtues.en: The disciples of Prophet Isa made this profound dua expressing their faith and asking to be counted among those who bear witness to the truth. It is a beautiful prayer for steadfastness in faith. (Quran 3:53)
virtues.ar: دعا به حواريو عيسى عليه السلام معبرين عن إيمانهم وسائلين أن يكتبوا من الشاهدين (القرآن 3:53)

title.en: The Dua of Those Who Reflect on Allah's Creation

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan, subhanaka faqina 'adhaban-nar.

translation.en: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such attributes]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
translation.ar: ربنا ما خلقت هذا باطلا سبحانك فقنا عذاب النار

virtues.en: This is the dua of those who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying on their sides, and reflect upon the creation of the heavens and the earth. A powerful dua for those who ponder Allah's signs. (Quran 3:191)
virtues.ar: دعاء الذين يذكرون الله قياماً وقعوداً وعلى جنوبهم ويتفكرون في خلق السماوات والأرض (القرآن 3:191)

title.en: The Dua of Those Who Reflect — Part 2

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۚ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana inna sami'na munadiyyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa-kaffir 'anna sayyi'atina wa-tawaffana ma'al-abrar. Rabbana wa-atina ma wa'adtana 'ala rusulika wa la tukhzina yawmal-qiyamah, innaka la tukhliful-mi'ad.

translation.en: Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], "Believe in your Lord," and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
translation.ar: ربنا إننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للإيمان أن آمنوا بربكم فآمنا ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سيئاتنا وتوفنا مع الأبرار ربنا وآتنا ما وعدتنا على رسلك ولا تخزنا يوم القيامة إنك لا تخلف الميعاد

virtues.en: This is the continuation of the dua of the people of understanding (Ulul Albab). It includes faith in Allah's call, forgiveness of sins, expiation of evil deeds, death with the righteous, fulfillment of Allah's promises, and protection from disgrace on Judgment Day. (Quran 3:193-194)
virtues.ar: استمرار دعاء أهل البصيرة يجمع بين الإيمان والمغفرة وتكفير السيئات والموت مع الأبرار (القرآن 3:193-194)

title.en: The Dua of Prophet Shu'ayb for Justice

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbanaftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqq wa anta khayrul-fatiheen.

translation.en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, for You are the best of those who give judgment.
translation.ar: ربنا افتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وأنت خير الفاتحين

virtues.en: Prophet Shu'ayb made this dua when his people rejected his message and threatened him. He entrusted the matter of justice entirely to Allah rather than seeking revenge. A beautiful dua when facing injustice. (Quran 7:89)
virtues.ar: دعا شعيب ربه حين رفض قومه رسالته وهددوه ففوض أمر العدل لله (القرآن 7:89)

title.en: The Believers' Dua for Patience and a Muslim Death
title.ar: دعاء المؤمنين بالصبر والموت على الإسلام

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana afrigh 'alayna sabran wa tawaffana muslimeen.

translation.en: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
translation.ar: ربنا أفرغ علينا صبرا وتوفنا مسلمين

virtues.en: The believing magicians of Pharaoh made this dua after seeing the truth of Musa's miracle and facing Pharaoh's threats. They chose death as Muslims over a life of disbelief. A powerful dua for steadfastness until death. (Quran 7:126)
virtues.ar: دعا به مؤمنو سحرة فرعون بعد أن آمنوا بموسى وواجهوا التهديد بالقطع (القرآن 7:126)

title.en: Prophet Musa's Dua to See Allah

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi arini anẓur ilayk.

translation.en: My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You.
translation.ar: رب أرني أنظر إليك

virtues.en: Prophet Musa made this extraordinary request out of his burning desire to draw closer to Allah. Allah responded that he could not bear to see Him, but revealed Himself to the mountain instead, causing it to crumble. This shows Musa's immense love for his Lord. (Quran 7:143)
virtues.ar: سأل موسى ربه هذا السؤال من شوقه لرؤيته فأخبره الله أنه لا يراه في الدنيا (القرآن 7:143)

title.en: Prophet Musa's Dua for Forgiveness for Himself and Harun

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ ۖ أَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa li-akhi wa-adkhilna fi rahmatik, anta arhamur-rahimeen.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
translation.ar: رب اغفر لي ولأخي وأدخلنا في رحمتك أنت أرحم الراحمين

virtues.en: Prophet Musa made this dua after the incident of the golden calf, asking forgiveness for himself and his brother Harun. It teaches us to include our siblings and family in our duas. (Quran 7:151)
virtues.ar: دعا موسى ربه بعد حادثة العجل الذهب طالباً المغفرة لنفسه وأخيه هارون (القرآن 7:151)

title.en: The Believers' Dua Not to Be Made a Trial for Oppressors
title.ar: دعاء المؤمنين ألا يكونوا فتنة للظالمين

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmith-thalimeen wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafireen.

translation.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للقوم الظالمين ونجنا برحمتك من القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: Prophet Musa and the believers made this dua, seeking protection from being overpowered by oppressors and from the harm of disbelievers. It is highly recommended for those living under tyranny or persecution. (Quran 10:85-86)
virtues.ar: دعا موسى والمؤمنون به ربهم مستعيذين من أن يغلبهم الظالمون (القرآن 10:85-86)

title.en: The Complete Dua of Prophet Yusuf

items.arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi qad ataytani minal-mulki wa'allamtani min ta'wilil-ahadith, fatiras-samawati wal-ardi anta waliyyi fid-dunya wal-akhirah, tawaffani musliman wa-alhiqni bis-salihin.

translation.en: My Lord, You have given me of sovereignty and taught me the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
translation.ar: رب قد آتيتني من الملك وعلمتني من تأويل الأحاديث فاطر السماوات والأرض أنت وليي في الدنيا والآخرة توفني مسلما وألحقني بالصالحين

virtues.en: Prophet Yusuf made this comprehensive dua after reuniting with his family and achieving power in Egypt. He acknowledged Allah's blessings, declared his complete reliance on Him, and prayed for a Muslim death and to be with the righteous. A model dua of gratitude and humility in success. (Quran 12:101)
virtues.ar: دعا يوسف ربه بعد أن جمع الله شمله وآتاه ملك مصر، يعترف بنعمة الله ويسأله حسن الخاتمة (القرآن 12:101)

title.en: Prophet Ibrahim's Dua for Makkah and Its People

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتِي بِوَادٍ غَيْرِ ذِي زَرْعٍ عِندَ بَيْتِكَ الْمُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنَا لِيُقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ فَاجْعَلْ أَفْئِدَةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ تَهْوِي إِلَيْهِمْ وَارْزُقْهُم مِّنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُونَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni askantu min dhurriyyati bi-wadin ghayri dhi zar'in 'inda baytikal-muharram, rabbana liyuqimus-salata fa-j'al af'idatan minan-nasi tahwi ilayhim, wa-rzuqhum minath-thamarati la'allahum yashkurun.

translation.en: My Lord, I have settled some of my offspring in an uncultivated valley near Your Sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
translation.ar: رب إني أسكنت من ذريتي بواد غير ذي زرع عند بيتك المحرم ربنا ليقيموا الصلاة فاجعل أفئدة من الناس تهوي إليهم وارزقهم من الثمرات لعلهم يشكرون

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim made this dua when leaving his family in the barren valley of Makkah. He prayed for them to establish prayer, for people's hearts to be drawn to them, and for their provision. Allah answered by making Makkah the center of pilgrimage for all humanity. (Quran 14:37)
virtues.ar: دعا إبراهيم حين ترك أهله في واد غير ذي زرع فاستجاب الله وجعل مكة قبلة العالم (القرآن 14:37)

title.en: The Dua for a Sound Entry and Exit

items.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
items.transliteration: Wa qul rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijni mukhraja sidq, waj'al li min ladunka sultanan naseera.

translation.en: And say, "My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and cause me to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority."
translation.ar: وقل رب أدخلني مدخل صدق وأخرجني مخرج صدق واجعل لي من لدنك سلطانا نصيرا

virtues.en: This dua was revealed to the Prophet (peace be upon him) during the migration from Makkah to Madinah. It is a comprehensive prayer for righteousness in all comings and goings, and for divine support. Recommended when starting any journey or new chapter in life. (Quran 17:80)
virtues.ar: نزلت على النبي ﷺ عند الهجرة من مكة إلى المدينة. دعاء شامل لكل مدخل ومخرج (القرآن 17:80)

title.en: The Detailed Dua of Prophet Zakariya

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُن بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا وَإِنِّي خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِيَ مِن وَرَائِي وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَتِي عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا يَرِثُنِي وَيَرِثُ مِنْ آلِ يَعْقُوبَ وَاجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni wahana-l-'azmu minni washtala'a-r-ra'su shayban, wa lam akun bidu'a'ika rabbi shaqiyya. Wa inni khaftul-mawaliya min wara'i, wa kanatim-ra'atu 'aqran, fa-hab li min ladunka waliyyan, yarithuni wa yaruthu min ali ya'qub, waj'alhu rabbi radiyya.

translation.en: My Lord, my bone has weakened and my head has flared with white hair, and I have never been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy. And indeed I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You].
translation.ar: رب إني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الرأس شيبا ولم أكن بدعائك رب شقيا وإني خفت الموالي من ورائي وكانت امرأتي عاقرا فهب لي من لدنك وليا يرثني ويرث من آل يعقوب واجعله رب رضيا

virtues.en: This is the more detailed version of Prophet Zakariya's dua as mentioned in Surah Maryam. He approached Allah with humility, acknowledging his old age, his wife's infertility, and his concern for the future of his mission. Allah answered by granting him Yahya (John the Baptist). (Quran 19:2-6)
virtues.ar: هذا النص الكامل لدعاء زكريا في سورة مريم أتى ربه متواضعاً مقراً بكبر سنه وعقم زوجته (القرآن 19:2-6)

title.en: Prophet Zakariya's Dua Not to Be Left Alone

items.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa-anta khayrul-waritheen.

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.
translation.ar: رب لا تذرني فردا وأنت خير الوارثين

virtues.en: Prophet Zakariya made this dua expressing his fear of being left without an heir. He acknowledged Allah as the best of inheritors, showing beautiful contentment with Allah's decree. (Quran 21:89)
virtues.ar: أظهر زكريا خوفه من أن يموت وحيداً معترفاً بأن الله خير الوارثين (القرآن 21:89)

title.en: The Dua for Allah to Judge with Truth

items.arabic: رَبِّ اقْضِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ رَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi qdi bil-haqq. Rabbana-rrahmanul-musta'anu 'ala ma tasifun.

translation.en: My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. Our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against what you describe.
translation.ar: رب اقض بالحق ربنا الرحمن المستعان على ما تصفون

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) was commanded to make this dua against the claims of the disbelievers. It affirms that ultimate justice belongs to Allah alone and that He is the one to seek help against falsehood. (Quran 21:112)
virtues.ar: أمر الله نبيه ﷺ أن يقول هذا الدعاء رداً على ادعاءات الكافرين (القرآن 21:112)

title.en: The Dua for Protection from Hellfire

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana-srif 'anna 'adhaba jahannam, inna 'adhabaha kana gharaman, innaha sa'at mustaqarran wa-muqaman.

translation.en: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering. Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.
translation.ar: ربنا اصرف عنا عذاب جهنم إن عذابها كان غراما إنها ساءت مستقرا ومقاما

virtues.en: This dua is made by the servants of the Most Merciful — those who walk humbly on earth and when the ignorant address them, they say words of peace. It shows that even the most righteous actively seek protection from Hellfire. (Quran 25:65-66)
virtues.ar: دعاء عباد الرحمن الذين يمشون على الأرض هوناً وإذا خاطبهم الجاهلون قالوا سلاماً (القرآن 25:65-66)

title.en: Prophet Ibrahim's Dua for Wisdom and Good Name

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حِكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li hikman wa-alhiqni bis-salihin, waj'al li lisanan sidqa fil-akharin, waj'alni min warathati jannatin-na'im.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous. And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations. And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
translation.ar: رب هب لي حكما وألحقني بالصالحين واجعل لي لسان صدق في الآخرين واجعلني من ورثة جنة النعيم

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim's comprehensive dua includes four key requests: wisdom (hukm), companionship of the righteous, a good reputation among future generations, and Paradise. The phrase "lisan sidq" (truthful tongue/good mention) was fulfilled as all prophets that followed Ibrahim praised him. (Quran 26:83-85)
virtues.ar: شمل دعاء إبراهيم أربعة مطالب: الحكمة وصحبة الصالحين والذكر الحسن والجنة (القرآن 26:83-85)

title.en: Prophet Musa's Dua Fleeing from Oppression
title.ar: دعاء موسى عند الهروب من فرعون

items.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi najjini minal-qawmith-thalimeen.

translation.en: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.
translation.ar: رب نجني من القوم الظالمين

virtues.en: Prophet Musa made this concise dua when fleeing Egypt after killing an Egyptian by mistake, with Pharaoh's forces pursuing him. It shows that in moments of danger, the best refuge is a short, sincere call to Allah. (Quran 28:21)
virtues.ar: دعا موسى ربه بهذا الدعاء الموجز وهو هارب من مصر وخلفه جنود فرعون (القرآن 28:21)

title.en: Prophet Musa's Dua in Madyan for Provision

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.

translation.en: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
translation.ar: رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير

virtues.en: Prophet Musa made this humble dua after helping the two daughters of Prophet Shu'ayb water their flocks, when he had nothing after his long journey. Despite being a prophet and having been a prince, he openly expressed his need for Allah's provision. (Quran 28:24)
virtues.ar: دعا موسى ربه بعد أن سقى لبنات شعيب وهو في أشد حالات الحاجة بعد رحلته الطويلة (القرآن 28:24)

title.en: Prophet Ibrahim's Dua for a Righteous Child

items.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi hab li minas-salihin.

translation.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.
translation.ar: رب هب لي من الصالحين

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim made this short but powerful dua in his old age. Allah responded by granting him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy, Ismail (Ishmael). The brevity of the dua shows that sincerity matters more than length. (Quran 37:100)
virtues.ar: دعا إبراهيم ربه بهذا الدعاء الموجز في كبر سنه فبشره الله بإسماعيل (القرآن 37:100)

title.en: Prophet Sulaiman's Dua for an Unmatched Kingdom
title.ar: دعاء سليمان للملك الذي لا ينبغي لأحد

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir li wa-hab li mulkan la yanbaghi li-ahadin min ba'di, innaka antal-wahhab.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
translation.ar: رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعدي إنك أنت الوهاب

virtues.en: Prophet Sulaiman began this dua by seeking forgiveness before asking for a kingdom. Allah answered his prayer and granted him dominion over jinn, humans, birds, and the wind — a kingdom never given to anyone before or after. It teaches the importance of seeking forgiveness before making requests. (Quran 38:35)
virtues.ar: بدأ سليمان دعاءه بالاستغفار قبل أن يسأل الملك فأعطاه الله ملكاً لم يؤت أحداً من قبله (القرآن 38:35)

title.en: The Angels' Dua for the Believers

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'in rahmatan wa'ilman fa-ghfir lilladhina tabu wa-ittaba'u sabīlaka, wa-qihim 'adhabal-jaheem. Rabbana wa-adkhilhum jannati 'adnin allati wa'adtahum wa man salaha min aba'ihim wa-azwajihim wa-dhurriyyatihim, innaka antal-'azizul-hakeem.

translation.en: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire. Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translation.ar: ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلاما فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك وقهم عذاب الجحيم ربنا وأدخلهم جنات عدن التي وعدتهم ومن صلح من آبائهم وأزواجهم وذرياتهم إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم

virtues.en: The angels carry the Throne of Allah and make this dua for the believers. They ask for forgiveness for the repentant, protection from Hell, and admission to Paradise — for the believers and their entire families. Reciting this dua connects you to the supplication of the angels. (Quran 40:7-8)
virtues.ar: الملائكة الحاملون للعرش يدعون بهذا الدعاء للمؤمنين. تدعو الملائكة للمؤمنين بالمغفرة والجنة (القرآن 40:7-8)

title.en: The Dua at the Age of Maturity

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي ۖ إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya, wa an a'mala salihan tardhah, wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati, inni tubtu ilayka wa-inni minal-muslimeen.

translation.en: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And correct for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed I am of the Muslims.
translation.ar: رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت علي وعلى والدي وأن أعمل صالحا ترضاه وأصلح لي في ذريتي إني تبت إليك وإني من المسلمين

virtues.en: Allah mentions that when a person reaches the age of forty, they should make this dua. It includes gratitude for blessings, doing righteous deeds, rectifying one's offspring, and repentance. A milestone dua for every stage of life. (Quran 46:15)
virtues.ar: ذكر الله أن من بلغ الأربعين ينبغي أن يدعو بهذا الدعاء الشامل للشكر والعمل الصالح والإصلاح (القرآن 46:15)

title.en: Prophet Ibrahim's Dua of Complete Reliance on Allah

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana 'alayka tawakkalna wa-ilayka anabna wa-ilaykal-masir. Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilladhina kafaru wa-ghfir lana rabbana innaka antal-'azizul-hakeem.

translation.en: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination. Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for those who disbelieve and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translation.ar: ربنا عليك توكلنا وإليك أنبنا وإليك المصير ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للذين كفروا واغفر لنا ربنا إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim and his followers made this declaration of complete reliance on Allah and disavowal of disbelief. It includes three pillars: tawakkul (reliance), inabah (turning to Allah), and seeking protection from being a trial for disbelievers. (Quran 60:4-5)
virtues.ar: أعلن إبراهيم وأتباعه توكلهم الكامل على الله وبراءتهم من الشرك (القرآن 60:4-5)

title.en: The Dua for Perfecting Light

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.transliteration: Rabbana atmim lana nurana wa-ghfir lana, innaka 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.

translation.en: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
translation.ar: ربنا أتمم لنا نورنا واغفر لنا إنك على كل شيء قدير

virtues.en: This dua is made by the believers who are described as having a light running before them and on their right on the Day of Judgment. They ask Allah to perfect this light so it is not extinguished. One of the most important duas for one's spiritual illumination and ultimate salvation. (Quran 66:8)
virtues.ar: دعاء المؤمنين الذين يقال لهم يوم القيامة: سلم عليكم ادخلوا الجنة بما كنتم تعملون (القرآن 66:8)

title.en: Prophet Nuh's Dua Against the Disbelievers and for the Believers

items.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّارًا إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوا إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًا
items.transliteration: Rabbi la tadhari 'alal-ardi minal-kafireen diyaran, innaka in tadharihum yudillu 'ibadaka wa la yalidu illa fajiran kaffaran. Rabbi-ghfir li wa-liwalidayya wa-li man dakhala bayti mu'minan, wa-lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minateena, wa la zidith-thalimeena illa tabaran.

translation.en: My Lord, do not leave upon the earth any disbeliever. Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and beget only [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever. My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.
translation.ar: رب لا تذر على الأرض من الكافرين ديارا إنك إن تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا إلا فاجرا كفارا رب اغفر لي ولوالدي ولمن دخل بيتي مؤمنا وللمؤمنين والمؤمنات ولا تزد الظالمين إلا تبارا

virtues.en: This is Prophet Nuh's final recorded dua after centuries of calling his people to Islam. It has two parts: a plea against the corrupting influence of disbelievers, and a comprehensive prayer of forgiveness for his parents, his household, and all believing men and women. (Quran 71:26-28)
virtues.ar: آخر دعاء نوح بعد قرون من الدعوة، جزآن: دعاء على إفساد الكافرين ودعاء للمؤمنين والمؤمنات بالمغفرة (القرآن 71:26-28)

title.en: The Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy — The Prophetic Prayer

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbighfir wa-rham wa-anta khayrur-rahimeen.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
translation.ar: رب اغفر وارحم وأنت خير الراحمين

virtues.en: Allah commanded the Prophet (peace be upon him) to say this dua. It is a concise yet comprehensive prayer combining forgiveness and mercy, affirming that Allah is the best of those who show mercy. (Quran 23:118)
virtues.ar: أمر الله نبيه ﷺ أن يقول هذا الدعاء الجامع بين المغفرة والرحمة (القرآن 23:118)

title.en: Prayer of Ibrahim for Makkah and His Children
title.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ مَنْ آمَنَ مِنْهُم بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi ij'al hadha baladan aminan warzuq ahlahu minath-thamarati man amana minhum billahi wal-yawmil-akhir.

translation.en: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and provide its people with fruits — whoever of them believes in Allah and the Last Day.
translation.ar: رب اجعل هذا بلدا آمنا وارزق أهله من الثمرات من آمن منهم بالله واليوم الآخر

virtues.en: Prophet Ibrahim made this prayer after leaving his family in the barren valley of Makkah. Allah answered it by making Makkah the most sacred city and providing its people with sustenance from all directions during Hajj.
virtues.ar: Prophet Ibrahim made this prayer after leaving his family in the barren valley of Makkah. Allah answered it by making Makkah the most sacred city and providing its people with sustenance from all directions during Hajj.

title.en: Ibrahim's Prayer for Righteous Offspring
title.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi ij'alni muqimass-salati wa min dhurriyyati, rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.

translation.en: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [among] my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
translation.ar: رب اجعلني مقيم الصلاة ومن ذريتي ربنا وتقبل دعاء

virtues.en: This prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail while raising the foundations of the Kaaba shows the priority they gave to establishing prayer and leaving a legacy of worship. The dua concludes with asking Allah to accept the supplication.
virtues.ar: This prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail while raising the foundations of the Kaaba shows the priority they gave to establishing prayer and leaving a legacy of worship. The dua concludes with asking Allah to accept the supplication.

title.en: Dua of Ibrahim for Submission to Allah
title.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka, wa arina manasikana wa tub `alayna innaka antat-tawwabur-rahim.

translation.en: Our Lord, make us both [fully] submitted to You and from our descendants a submitting nation. Show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
translation.ar: ربنا واجعلنا مسلمين لك ومن ذريتنا أمة مسلمة لك وأرنا مناسكنا وتب علينا إنك أنت التواب الرحيم

virtues.en: This is the prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail as they built the Kaaba together. It teaches that the greatest legacy a parent can leave is a family submitted to Allah.
virtues.ar: This is the prayer of Ibrahim and Ismail as they built the Kaaba together. It teaches that the greatest legacy a parent can leave is a family submitted to Allah.

title.en: Allah Does Not Burden a Soul Beyond Its Capacity
title.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, rabbana wa la tahmil `alayna isran kama hamaltahu `alalladhina min qablina, rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihi, wa `fu `anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna `alal-qawmil-kafirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, do not burden us with that which we have no ability to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا أو أخطأنا ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا كما حملته على الذين من قبلنا ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا أنت مولانا فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: This verse was revealed in response to the believers' concern about the commands and prohibitions. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that when Allah said "I will do it," the angels said "Amin." It is one of the most comprehensive duas encompassing pardon, forgiveness, mercy, and victory.

The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that when Allah said "I will do it," the angels said "Amin." It is one of the most comprehensive duas encompassing pardon, forgiveness, mercy, and victory.

title.en: The Inheritance Prayer of An-Nisa
title.ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ

items.arabic: وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَٰكِن كَرِهَ اللَّهُ انبِعَاثَهُمْ فَثَبَّطَهُمْ وَقِيلَ اقْعُدُوا مَعَ الْقَاعِدِينَ ۔ رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbanaftah baynana wa bayna qawmina bil-haqqi wa anta khayrul-fatehin.

translation.en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of judges.
translation.ar: ربنا افتح بيننا وبين قومنا بالحق وأنت خير الفاتحين

virtues.en: This prayer is made by the oppressed who are unable to defend themselves against injustice. It is a powerful supplication for those who face persecution and seek Allah's intervention to establish truth and justice between them and their oppressors.
virtues.ar: This prayer is made by the oppressed who are unable to defend themselves against injustice. It is a powerful supplication for those who face persecution and seek Allah's intervention to establish truth and justice between them and their oppressors.

title.en: Prayer for Forgiveness and Mercy
title.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lana dhunubana wa israfana fi amrina wa thabbit aqdamana wansurna `alal-qawmil-kafirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excess [in our affairs] and plant our feet firmly and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا اغفر لنا ذنوبنا وإسرافنا في أمرنا وثبت أقدامنا وانصرنا على القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: This is the dua of those who were tested by fighting and remained patient. It combines seeking forgiveness for sins and excesses, asking for steadfastness, and requesting victory — a complete prayer for the believer facing trials.
virtues.ar: This is the dua of those who were tested by fighting and remained patient. It combines seeking forgiveness for sins and excesses, asking for steadfastness, and requesting victory — a complete prayer for the believer facing trials.

title.en: Prayer for Garden of Eden
title.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ ۔ رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۔ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytahu wa ma liz-zalimina min ansar. Rabbana innana sami'na munadiyan yunadi lil-imani an aminu birabbikum fa-amanna. Rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wa kaffir `anna sayyi'atina wa tawaffana ma'al-abrar.

translation.en: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire — You have disgraced him. And for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, saying, "Believe in your Lord," so we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
translation.ar: ربنا إنك من تدخل النار فقد أخزيته وما للظالمين من أنصار ربنا إننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للإيمان أن آمنوا بربكم فآمنا ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سيئاتنا وتوفنا مع الأبرار

virtues.en: This is a continuation of the prayer of those who reflect upon Allah's creation. It includes one of the most beautiful requests: to die among the righteous. The scholars emphasize the importance of asking Allah for a good ending (husn al-khatimah).
virtues.ar: This is a continuation of the prayer of those who reflect upon Allah's creation. It includes one of the most beautiful requests: to die among the righteous. The scholars emphasize the importance of asking Allah for a good ending (husn al-khatimah).

title.en: Prayer for Rescue of the Oppressed
title.ar: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana akhrijna min hadhihil-qaryatiz-zalima ahluha waj'al lana min ladunka waliyyan waj'al lana min ladunka nasiran.

translation.en: Our Lord, take us out of this city of oppressive people and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and appoint for us from Yourself a helper.
translation.ar: ربنا أخرجنا من هذه القرية الظالم أهلها واجعل لنا من لدنك وليا واجعل لنا من لدنك نصيرا

virtues.en: This dua is for those who are oppressed and living under unjust rule. It asks Allah for a protector and helper, recognizing that true support comes only from Allah. It is especially relevant for those facing persecution.
virtues.ar: This dua is for those who are oppressed and living under unjust rule. It asks Allah for a protector and helper, recognizing that true support comes only from Allah. It is especially relevant for those facing persecution.

title.en: Prayer for Orphans and Weak
title.ar: وَخَافُوا يَوْمًا لَّا يَجْزِي وَالِدٌ عَن وَلَدِهِ

items.arabic: وَلْيَخْشَ الَّذِينَ لَوْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّةً ضِعَافًا خَافُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلْيَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلْيَقُولُوا قَوْلًا سَدِيدًا
items.transliteration: Falyattaqilladhina law tarakoo min khalfihim dhurriyyatan da'afan khafoo `alayhim falyattaqullah wa liyaqooloo qawlan sadeedan.

translation.en: Let those [executors and guardians] fear [injustice] as if they [themselves] had left weak offspring behind them and feared for them. So let them fear Allah and speak words of appropriate justice.
translation.ar: وليتق الذين لو تركوا من خلفهم ذرية ضعافا خافوا عليهم فليتقوا الله وليقولوا قولا سديدا

virtues.en: While not a direct dua, this verse inspires the prayer to be just to orphans and the weak, treating them as one would want one's own vulnerable children to be treated. It serves as a reminder of our duty toward those under our care.
virtues.ar: While not a direct dua, this verse inspires the prayer to be just to orphans and the weak, treating them as one would want one's own vulnerable children to be treated. It serves as a reminder of our duty toward those under our care.

title.en: Prayer of Complete Submission
title.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ

items.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۔ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَٰلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Qul inna salati wa nusuki wa mahyaya wa mamati lillahi rabbil-'alamin. La sharika lahu wa bidhalika umirtu wa ana awwalul-muslimin.

translation.en: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds. No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."
translation.ar: قل إن صلاتي ونسكي ومحياي ومماتي لله رب العالمين لا شريك له وبذلك أمرت وأنا أول المسلمين

virtues.en: This verse represents the ultimate declaration of a Muslim's complete submission to Allah. It encompasses every aspect of life — prayer, sacrifice, living, and dying — all dedicated solely to Allah. It is a powerful statement of pure tawheed and sincerity.
virtues.ar: This verse represents the ultimate declaration of a Muslim's complete submission to Allah. It encompasses every aspect of life — prayer, sacrifice, living, and dying — all dedicated solely to Allah. It is a powerful statement of pure tawheed and sincerity.

title.en: Prayer to Show Us the Reality
title.ar: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا

items.arabic: قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَتَاكُمْ عَذَابُ اللَّهِ بَغْتَةً أَوْ جَهْرَةً هَلْ يُهْلَكُ إِلَّا الْقَوْمُ الظَّالِمُونَ
items.transliteration: Qul ara'aytum in atakum 'adhabullahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illal-qawmuz-zalimun.

translation.en: Say, "Have you considered: if the punishment of Allah should come to you unexpectedly or manifestly, will any be destroyed except the wrongdoing people?"
translation.ar: قل أرأيتم إن أتاكم عذاب الله بغتة أو جهرة هل يهلك إلا القوم الظالمون

virtues.en: This verse serves as both a warning and a reflection. It reminds that Allah's punishment, whether sudden or expected, only destroys the wrongdoers. It encourages the believer to reflect on their deeds and seek Allah's protection from being among the wrongdoers.

title.en: Prayer of the People of A'raf
title.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ

items.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ أَصْحَابُ الْأَعْرَافِ رِجَالًا يَعْرِفُونَهُمْ بِسِيمَاهُمْ قَالُوا مَا أَغْنَىٰ عَنكُمْ جَمْعُكُمْ وَمَا كُنتُمْ تَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۔ أَهَٰؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ أَقْسَمْتُمْ لَا يَنَالُهُمُ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ ۔ رَبَّنَا ادْخُلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna ma'al-qawmiz-zalimin.

translation.en: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تجعلنا مع القوم الظالمين

virtues.en: This is the cry of the people on the Heights (Al-A'raf) — those whose deeds are balanced — calling out to Allah as they see the wrongdoers being turned away from Paradise. It is a prayer to be kept away from the company and fate of the unjust.
virtues.ar: This is the cry of the people on the Heights (Al-A'raf) — those whose deeds are balanced — calling out to Allah as they see the wrongdoers being turned away from Paradise. It is a prayer to be kept away from the company and fate of the unjust.

title.en: Musa's Prayer Upon Seeing Allah's Manifestation

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَرِنِي أَنظُرْ إِلَيْكَ ۖ قَالَ لَن تَرَانِي وَلَٰكِنِ انظُرْ إِلَى الْجَبَلِ فَإِنِ اسْتَقَرَّ مَكَانَهُ فَسَوْفَ تَرَانِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi arini anzhur ilayk.

translation.en: My Lord, show me [ Yourself ] that I may look at You.
translation.ar: رب أرني أنظر إليك

virtues.en: This was Musa's passionate request to see Allah. Though Allah informed him that he could not bear to see Him directly, this dua reveals the depth of Musa's longing and love for his Lord. The mountain crumbled at Allah's manifestation, showing the immense power of the Divine.
virtues.ar: This was Musa's passionate request to see Allah. Though Allah informed him that he could not bear to see Him directly, this dua reveals the depth of Musa's longing and love for his Lord. The mountain crumbled at Allah's manifestation, showing the immense power of the Divine.

title.en: Musa's Prayer for Forgiveness

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ ۖ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa li-akhi wa adkhilna fi rahmatik, wa anta arhamur-rahimin.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.
translation.ar: رب اغفر لي ولأخي وأدخلنا في رحمتك وأنت أرحم الراحمين

virtues.en: Musa made this prayer after the incident of the golden calf, asking forgiveness for himself and his brother Harun. It teaches the importance of interceding for family members and seeking Allah's vast mercy. It is a beautiful dua for sibling relationships.
virtues.ar: Musa made this prayer after the incident of the golden calf, asking forgiveness for himself and his brother Harun. It teaches the importance of interceding for family members and seeking Allah's vast mercy. It is a beautiful dua for sibling relationships.

title.en: Musa's Prayer for Guidance
title.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۔ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۔ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
items.transliteration: Rabbishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri, wahlul `uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري واحلل عقدة من لساني يفقهوا قولي

virtues.en: This was the dua of Musa before going to Pharaoh. It is one of the most beautiful duas for anyone facing a difficult task, public speaking, or a daunting mission. The Prophet (peace be upon him) used to recite this dua when something distressed him. Scholars recommend it for anyone experiencing anxiety or facing a challenge.

title.en: Musa's Prayer of Gratitude
title.ar: رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ

items.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Qala rabbi bima an'amta `alayya falan akuna zhahiran lil-mujrimin.

translation.en: [Musa] said, "My Lord, by the favor You have bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
translation.ar: قال رب بما أنعمت علي فلن أكون ظهيرا للمجرمين

virtues.en: Musa made this prayer after killing a man unintentionally and fleeing the city. It expresses gratitude for Allah's blessings and a firm commitment to never support wrongdoing. It is a powerful dua for resolving to stand with truth and justice.

title.en: Prayer of the Believers with Musa
title.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ۔ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ۔ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lil-qawmiz-zalimin. Wa najjina birahmatika minal-qawmil-kafirin.

translation.en: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people. And save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للقوم الظالمين ونجنا برحمتك من القوم الكافرين

virtues.en: This is the dua of the believers who followed Musa, made as they were trapped between the sea and Pharaoh's army. It contains two crucial requests: not to be made a trial for the oppressors (i.e., not to be defeated in a way that emboldens them) and to be saved by Allah's mercy.
virtues.ar: This is the dua of the believers who followed Musa, made as they were trapped between the sea and Pharaoh's army. It contains two crucial requests: not to be made a trial for the oppressors (i.e., not to be defeated in a way that emboldens them) and to be saved by Allah's mercy.

title.en: Prayer for Guidance from the Heart
title.ar: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِّن دِينِي

items.arabic: وَمَا أَتْبَعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
items.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu in kuntum fi shakkin min dini...

translation.en: Say, "O mankind, if you are in doubt as to my religion..."
translation.ar: قل يا أيها الناس إن كنتم في شك من ديني...

virtues.en: While this verse is a statement rather than a direct supplication, it reflects the believer's conviction in following revelation. Scholars derive from it the importance of praying for certainty in faith and clarity of religion when one experiences doubt.
virtues.ar: While this verse is a statement rather than a direct supplication, it reflects the believer's conviction in following revelation. Scholars derive from it the importance of praying for certainty in faith and clarity of religion when one experiences doubt.

title.en: Ibrahim's Prayer for His Parents
title.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir li wa liwalidayya walil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.

translation.en: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
translation.ar: ربنا اغفر لي ولوالدي وللمؤمنين يوم يقوم الحساب

virtues.en: This is Ibrahim's prayer for his parents and all believers. It shows the importance of praying for one's parents and the wider Muslim community. The prayer is connected to the Day of Judgment, reminding us of the ultimate accountability.
virtues.ar: This is Ibrahim's prayer for his parents and all believers. It shows the importance of praying for one's parents and the wider Muslim community. The prayer is connected to the Day of Judgment, reminding us of the ultimate accountability.

title.en: Ibrahim's Prayer for Security and Provision

items.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
items.transliteration: Rabbij'al hadhal-balada aminan wajnubni wa banayya an na'budal-asnam.

translation.en: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
translation.ar: رب اجعل هذا البلد آمنا واجنبني وبني أن نعبد الأصنام

virtues.en: Ibrahim's prayer combines asking for the security of Makkah with seeking protection for himself and his descendants from the greatest sin — associating partners with Allah. It shows that the most important thing to pray for regarding one's children is their faith and tawheed.

title.en: Prayer of the Companions of the Cave
title.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
items.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashad.

translation.en: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
translation.ar: ربنا آتنا من لدنك رحمة وهيئ لنا من أمرنا رشدا

virtues.en: This is the dua of the Ashab al-Kahf (People of the Cave) — young believers who fled religious persecution and took refuge in a cave. This short but comprehensive dua asks for Allah's mercy and guidance in all affairs. The Prophet (peace be upon him) encouraged learning this surah and making this dua for guidance in difficult decisions.

title.en: Zakariya's Prayer When Alone
title.ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا

items.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّي وَاشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا وَلَمْ أَكُن بِدُعَائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
items.transliteration: Rabbi inni wahanal-'azmu minni washta'alar-ra'su shayban wa lam akun bidu'a'ika rabbi shaqiyya.

translation.en: My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
translation.ar: رب إني وهن العظم مني واشتعل الرأس شيبا ولم أكن بدعائك رب شقيا

virtues.en: Zakariya poured out his heart to Allah, describing his physical decline while affirming his unwavering trust in Allah's response to his prayers. This dua teaches that one should never lose hope in Allah, regardless of age or circumstances.
virtues.ar: Zakariya poured out his heart to Allah, describing his physical decline while affirming his unwavering trust in Allah's response to his prayers. This dua teaches that one should never lose hope in Allah, regardless of age or circumstances.

title.en: Prayer for Increase in Knowledge

items.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
items.transliteration: Wa qul rabbi zidni `ilma.

translation.en: And say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
translation.ar: وقل رب زدني علما

virtues.en: This is one of the most famous duas for knowledge. It was revealed to the Prophet (peace be upon him) and is considered the most comprehensive prayer for seeking knowledge. The scholars emphasize that even the most knowledgeable person should continue to ask Allah for more knowledge, as knowledge has no limit.

title.en: Musa's Complete Prayer for His Mission
title.ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي

items.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي ۔ وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي ۔ يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي ۔ وَاجْعَل لِّي وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِي ۔ هَارُونَ أَخِي ۔ اشْدُدْ بِهِ أَزْرِي ۔ وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِي أَمْرِي
items.transliteration: Rabbi'shrah li sadri wa yassir li amri, wahlul `uqdata min lisani yafqahu qawli, waj'al li waziran min ahli, Haruna akhi, shdud bihi azri, wa ashhikhu fi amri.

translation.en: My Lord, expand for me my breast, ease for me my task, untie the knot from my tongue, make for me a minister from my family — Aaron, my brother. Strengthen me through him and share my task with him.
translation.ar: رب اشرح لي صدري ويسر لي أمري واحلل عقدة من لساني يفقهوا قولي واجعل لي وزيرا من أهلي هارون أخي اشدد به أزري وأشركه في أمري

virtues.en: This is Musa's complete prayer before his mission to Pharaoh. It includes asking for: an expanded heart (confidence), ease in the task, clarity of speech, a supportive companion, and shared responsibility. The Prophet (peace be upon him) would recite the first part when distressed.
virtues.ar: This is Musa's complete prayer before his mission to Pharaoh. It includes asking for: an expanded heart (confidence), ease in the task, clarity of speech, a supportive companion, and shared responsibility. The Prophet (peace be upon him) would recite the first part when distressed.

title.en: Prayer Against Shaytan's Whispers
title.ar: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ

items.arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ ۔ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin, wa a'udhu bika rabbi an yahdurun.

translation.en: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
translation.ar: رب أعوذ بك من همزات الشياطين وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون

virtues.en: This dua specifically seeks refuge from the devils' incitements and their presence. It is particularly powerful against waswas (whispers). The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught that the Shaytan flows through the son of Adam like blood, and this dua helps block those channels of whispering.
