The Prophet (peace be upon him) taught that the Shaytan flows through the son of Adam like blood, and this dua helps block those channels of whispering.

title.en: Prayer for Mercy and Righteous Deeds
title.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

items.arabic: فَقُلْ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Fa-qul rabbi ighfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin.

translation.en: So say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
translation.ar: فقل رب اغفر وارحم وأنت خير الراحمين

virtues.en: This short but profound dua appears at the end of Surah Al-Mu'minun. It combines the two most essential requests — forgiveness and mercy — and acknowledges that Allah is the best of those who show mercy. The scholars note that ending one's daily worship with this dua is highly meritorious.

title.en: Nuh's Prayer for Victory

items.arabic: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi  ansurni bima kadhdhabun.

translation.en: My Lord, help me because they have denied me.
translation.ar: رب انصرني بما كذبون

virtues.en: Nuh made this prayer after centuries of calling his people to Allah with only a handful of followers. It teaches that when one is patient in da'wah and faces rejection, turning to Allah for help is the response. Nuh was ultimately vindicated when the flood came upon the disbelievers.

title.en: Prayer of Nuh for Forgiveness
title.ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا

items.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
items.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa liwalidayya wa li-man dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat.

translation.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my home a believer and the believing men and believing women.
translation.ar: رب اغفر لي ولوالدي ولمن دخل بيتي مؤمنا وللمؤمنين والمؤمنات

virtues.en: This is one of the most expansive prayers for forgiveness in the Quran. Nuh prayed not only for himself and his parents but for every believer who entered his home and all believing men and women. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that whoever prays for the believers receives a supplication from every believer on earth in return.

title.en: Hud's Prayer for Reliance on Allah
title.ar: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم

items.arabic: إِنِّي تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مَّا مِن دَابَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّي عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
items.transliteration: Inni tawakkaltu `alallahi rabbi wa rabbikum, ma min dabbatin illa huwa akhidhun binasiyatiha, inna rabbi `ala siratin mustaqim.

translation.en: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a straight path.
translation.ar: إني توكلت على الله ربي وربكم ما من دابة إلا هو آخذ بناصيتها إن ربي على صراط مستقيم

virtues.en: This is the statement of Prophet Hud to his people, expressing complete reliance on Allah. The imagery of Allah holding every creature by its forelock demonstrates His absolute control over all creation. This serves as a powerful reminder to place full trust in Allah.

title.en: Yusuf's Prayer for Prison
title.ar: رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ

items.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
items.transliteration: Qala rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimma yad'unani ilayh, wa illa tasrif `anni kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa akun minal-jahilin.

translation.en: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."
translation.ar: قال رب السجن أحب إلي مما يدعونني إليه وإلا تصرف عني كيدهن أصب إليهن وأكن من الجاهلين

virtues.en: Yusuf made this dua when faced with the ultimate test — the advances of the Aziz's wife. He chose prison over disobedience to Allah, asking Allah to protect him from their plot. This dua is a model for anyone facing temptation, teaching that seeking refuge in Allah is the path of the righteous.

title.en: Yaqub's Prayer in Grief
title.ar: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ

items.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
items.transliteration: Innama ashku bathi wa huzni ilallahi, wa a'lamu minallahi ma la ta'lamun.

translation.en: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.
translation.ar: إنما أشكو بثي وحزني إلى الله وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون

virtues.en: Yaqub (Jacob) made this statement while grieving the loss of his beloved son Yusuf. Despite his overwhelming sorrow and going blind from weeping, he directed all his complaints only to Allah. This teaches that while it is permissible to express grief, the believer's ultimate recourse is always to Allah alone.
virtues.ar: Yaqub (Jacob) made this statement while grieving the loss of his beloved son Yusuf. Despite his overwhelming sorrow and going blind from weeping, he directed all his complaints only to Allah. This teaches that while it is permissible to express grief, the believer's ultimate recourse is always to Allah alone.

title.en: Ayyub's Prayer in Affliction
title.ar: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ

items.arabic: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Wa Ayyuba idh nada rabbahu anni massaniyad-durru wa anta arhamur-rahimin.

translation.en: And [remember] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
translation.ar: وأيوب إذ نادى ربه أني مسني الضر وأنت أرحم الراحمين

virtues.en: Despite years of severe illness, loss of wealth, and family trials, Ayyub's prayer was remarkably brief — only acknowledging his affliction and Allah's mercy. Allah responded by curing him completely and replacing what he lost with even more. This dua teaches that the key to having prayers answered is recognizing Allah's mercy.

title.en: Yunus's Prayer in the Whale — Dhul Nun
title.ar: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ

items.arabic: وَذَا النُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ أَن لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: Wa dhann-nuni idh dhahaba mughidhan fa dhanna an lan naqdira `alayhi fanada fidh-dhulumat, an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin.

translation.en: And [remember] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
translation.ar: وذا النون إذ ذهب مغاضبا فظن أن لن نقدر عليه فنادى في الظلمات أن لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك إني كنت من الظالمين

virtues.en: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "No Muslim makes a supplication containing these words but Allah will answer it." This dua was made by Yunus in three layers of darkness: the darkness of the sea, the darkness of the whale, and the darkness of the night. It is the most powerful dua for relief from distress and is called "Dhul-Nun."

title.en: Prayer for Steadfastness in Da'wah

items.arabic: رَبِّ اقْضِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبِّنَا الصَّمُدُ
items.transliteration: Rabbiqdi bayni wa baynahum bil-haqq, wa rabbunas-samad.

translation.en: My Lord, judge between me and my people in truth.
translation.ar: رب اقض بيني وبينهم بالحق وربنا الصمد

virtues.en: This was the prayer of the Prophet (peace be upon him) as recorded in the Quran, asking Allah to judge between him and his opponents. It is a dua for anyone facing opposition or injustice, placing the matter in Allah's hands and trusting in His perfect judgment.

title.en: The Angels' Prayer for the Believers
title.ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
items.transliteration: Rabbana wasi'ta kulla shay'in rahmatan wa `ilman faghfir lilladhina tabu wattaba'u sabilak, wa qihim 'adhabal-jaheem.

translation.en: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
translation.ar: ربنا وسعت كل شيء رحمة وعلمًا فاغفر للذين تابوا واتبعوا سبيلك وقهم عذاب الجحيم

virtues.en: The angels who carry the Throne and those around it make this prayer for the believers. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said that this dua will intercede for the person who recites it. It is one of the most powerful prayers for forgiveness, combining Allah's vast mercy and knowledge.

title.en: Prayer Following Ibrahim's Example
title.ar: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana `alayka tawakkalna wa ilayka anabna wa ilaykal-masir.

translation.en: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
translation.ar: ربنا عليك توكلنا وإليك أنبنا وإليك المصير

virtues.en: This is the dua of Ibrahim and his followers when they declared disassociation from the idolaters. It expresses complete reliance on Allah, turning to Him in repentance, and recognizing that all things return to Him. It is a powerful declaration of tawakkul (trust in Allah).

title.en: Prayer for Salvation from the Fire
title.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana la taj'alna fitnatan lilladhina kafaru waghfir lana rabbana, innaka antal-'azizul-hakim.

translation.en: Our Lord, make us not [a cause of] trial for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
translation.ar: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للذين كفروا واغفر لنا ربنا إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم

virtues.en: This dua follows the previous one, where Ibrahim and his followers pray not to be made a trial for the disbelievers — meaning not to be defeated in a way that strengthens disbelief. It is a prayer for strength, forgiveness, and wisdom in the face of opposition.

title.en: Prayer of Those Who Reflect on Creation
title.ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ

items.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ۔ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ
items.transliteration: Rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina adhaban-nar. Rabbana innaka man tudkhilin-nara faqad akhzaytahu.

translation.en: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You. So save us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire — You have disgraced him.
translation.ar: ربنا ما خلقت هذا باطلا سبحانك فقنا عذاب النار ربنا إنك من تدخل النار فقد أخزيته

virtues.en: This is the prayer that emerges from deep reflection on the creation of the heavens and the earth. The people of understanding, who remember Allah standing, sitting, and lying down, make this dua. It teaches that reflection on creation should lead to dua and awareness of the Hereafter.

title.en: Prayer of Maryam for Protection

items.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِالرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
items.transliteration: Qalat inni a'udhu bir-rahmani mink, in kunta taqiyya.

translation.en: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing [Allah]."
translation.ar: قالت إني أعوذ بالرحمن منك إن كنت تقيا

virtues.en: Maryam (Mary) made this statement when the angel appeared before her in the form of a man. It demonstrates the importance of seeking Allah's protection in situations of uncertainty. Scholars derive from this the permissibility of seeking refuge in Allah when one faces any concerning situation.

title.en: Prayer of Ash-Shura for No Desire Except Allah's

items.arabic: تَنْزِيلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
items.transliteration: Tanzilun minar-rahmanir-rahim.

translation.en: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
translation.ar: تنزيل من الرحمن الرحيم

virtues.en: The angels in the heavens exalt Allah and seek forgiveness for those on earth. This verse reminds believers that the angels are constantly praying for them, which should increase their gratitude and motivation to worship. The connection between the angels' supplication and the believers' deeds is a source of hope and encouragement.

title.en: Prayer of Luqman for Gratitude

items.arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا لُقْمَانَ الْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ اشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِ
items.transliteration: Wa laqad atayna Luqmanal-hikmata anishkurillah, wa man yashkur fa-innama yashkuru linafsih.

translation.en: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [saying], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself.
translation.ar: ولقد آتينا لقمان الحكمة أن اشكر لله ومن يشكر فإنما يشكر لنفسه

virtues.en: Luqman's wisdom began with the command to be grateful to Allah. The verse makes clear that gratitude benefits the grateful person themselves. This teaches that gratitude is not merely a polite gesture but a transformative act that benefits one's own soul, faith, and worldly life.

title.en: Surah An-Nasr — The Prayer of Gratitude and Repentance

items.arabic: إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ ۔ وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا ۔ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا ۔ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۔ إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ ۔ وَرَأَيْتَ النَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا ۔ فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
items.transliteration: Idha jaa nasrullahi wal-fath. Wa ra'aitan-nasa yadkhuluna fi dinillahi afwaj. Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirhu, innahu kana tawwab.

translation.en: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest, and you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes, then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
translation.ar: إذا جاء نصر الله والفتح ورأيت الناس يدخلون في دين الله أفواجا فسبح بحمد ربك واستغفره إنه كان توابا

virtues.en: This surah was revealed after the conquest of Makkah. Despite this monumental victory, Allah commanded the Prophet (peace be upon him) to glorify Him and seek forgiveness. It teaches that at the height of success, a believer should remain humble, grateful, and seek forgiveness, never allowing worldly achievements to make them forget their dependence on Allah.
